Beginner or advanced, become a chess master, without ever being disturbed by ads.

Do you want to master the most prestigious, the classiest game ever, while having fun?

It's EASY! For starters, there are no ads to distract you. There's no account to create, and you don't even need to be connected to the Internet.

So, how does it work?

If you are a beginner, let yourself be guided by the introductory lessons included. The lessons are SHORT and EASY. Right from the start, you begin playing by moving pieces, and you learn the rules of the game while having fun. The first 40 lessons are free.

Once you know the rules, you start playing real games! The coach shows you the moves a Grandmaster would pick. Not just one move, but THE 4 BEST MOVES.

Sounds too simple? But think about it... How did you learn to speak as a child? Did you take grammar and spelling lessons? Of course not. You listened to the adults talk and then you went for it! Because that's how you learn!

This app allows you to do just that, AND IT WORKS!

From the very first games, you start learning effortlessly. You immediately enjoy playing, and after a while you notice that the right moves come to mind naturally, as if they were obvious.

Gradually, you deactivate the suggestions and play by yourself. At the end of each game, the coach shows you the good and bad moves you've made. You can better understand what happened, and you can even try out other moves to improve.

If this sounds unbelievable, you should read the user reviews for our app. It has one of the highest satisfaction ratings on the App Store, in all countries.


FOR BEGINNERS, THIS APP...

• contains introductory chess lessons that are suitable even for children. The first 40 are free.
• shows you all the possible moves of a piece when you touch it.
• explains why certain moves are forbidden.
• can suggest 4 to 6 excellent moves at any one time. The green button lets you show or hide these suggestions.
• can tell you when you can mate

**BUILT ON DISTRIBUTED RECALL™**

The same spaced-repetition science behind every serious study tool (Cepeda et al., 2006), delivered where you actually pick up your phone. Cards you struggle with surface more often. Cards you've mastered get out of your way. You don't have to remember to open the app — you already do, 96 times a day.

**ANKI ONLY WORKS WHEN YOU OPEN ANKI**

We work because you open your phone. Move to China and you'll learn Chinese without trying — you can't help it. ScrollToll does the same thing for the MCAT (and SAT, USMLE prep, mental math, vocabulary, chess, and any topic you want to learn passively).

**HOW IT WORKS**

1. Pick the apps that waste your time
2. ScrollToll locks them behind a single question
3. Solve it — usually an MCAT question, mental math problem, chess tactic, or vocabulary card
4. Get 5 minutes, then it relocks automatically
5. Every unlock IS a study session — distributed across your real day

**WHO IT'S FOR**

- Premeds prepping for the MCAT who want discipline they can't fake
- Med students grinding USMLE Step 1
- Students who open Instagram "for a second" and lose an evening
- Professionals who lose hours to their phone during deep work
- Anyone who's tried Anki, fallen off, and wants the spacing without the discipline tax

**THE MATH**

The average person unlocks their phone 96 times per day. ScrollToll turns 50+ of those into deliberate, spaced-practice moments. In a month, you've passively practiced over 1,400 questions — without ever sitting down with a textbook.

**REAL BLOCKING, NOT A SUGGESTION**

ScrollToll uses Apple's Screen Time API to block apps at the OS level. No overlay you can swipe away. No "are you sure?" button. When an app is locked, it's locked — until you earn your way in.

- OS-level blocking — can't be bypassed or dismissed

LAN scanner:

- IP addresses of all discovered devices
- MAC addresses and vendor names of discovered devices
- NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour), LLMNR, DNS, SNMP, and WS-Discovery name where available
- Reachability (ping) test of discovered devices
- IPv6 availability and discovered IPv6 addresses

Ping & traceroute:
- Round-trip delay including IP address and hostname for every network node
- Country detection of the analyzed server
- Support for both IPv4 and IPv6

Port scanner:
- Scan common ports, custom port ranges, or the complete port range
- Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports
- Description of the known open port services

Whois:
- Look up domains, IP addresses, and AS numbers
- Support for both classic whois and the modern RDAP protocol

DNS lookup:
- Functionality similar to nslookup or dig
- Query all record types at once or one specific type
- Support for A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, TXT records

Network information:
- Default gateway, external IP (v4 and v6), DNS server, HTTP proxy
- Wi-Fi network information such as SSID, BSSID, router vendor, security type, IP address (v4 and v6), and subnet mask
- VPN, USB Ethernet, and personal hotspot connection details
- Cell network information such as IP address
